integrity: The proof and standalone finite numerical diagnostics are supplied. No independent audit has been conducted. The finite diagnostics are not substitutes for general proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only the Euclidean perimeters within the complete maximum-area family of inscribed polygons on a noncircular ellipse are classified; not maximum perimeter among all inscribed polygons. Historical overlap with inaccessible older full papers cannot be excluded.
title: Exact perimeter selection among maximum-area polygons inscribed in ellipses
